text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A little while after the Kikuka-sho ended, 
news arrived that Mihono Bourbon would be 
taking a long-term break due to an injury.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon looked despondent, unsure 
of when she could return to racing, while 
Rice Shower was left at a loss, having 
lost the back she had chased for so long.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While Matikanetannhauser is worrying about 
the two of them, she receives a message 
from Nice Nature.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature told Matikanetannhauser how 
much courage she had given her over time, 
expressing her gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing this reminded Matikane Tannhauser 
of what Chairwoman Akikawa had once told 
her: "It was only because it was you that 
I could give you that push."
